notes.title: DREADTOME 1.2 - Improvements & Fixes!
notes.content: [p][b][u]Changes in this update:[/u][/b][/p][list][*][p]Difficulties have been tweaked, and brandish new names.[/p][/*][*][p]More objects react to your repulsor[/p][/*][*][p]Improved enemy animations & textures[/p][/*][*][p]Many performance improvements[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed many instances of soft-locks[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed instances of lighting & environment clipping[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed many settings issues, including key rebindings & audio levels.[/p][/*][*][p]Made portals consistent to prevent invisible collisions.[/p][/*][*][p]Increased maximum possible camera sensitivity, for more comfortable controller gameplay.[/p][/*][*][p]Added more  [spoiler]rat mode VFX & Ratues (Rat statues) [/spoiler][/p][p][/p][/*][/list][p][b]Our student project has wrapped up - the game will no longer receive any updates.[/b][/p][p][b]Thank you so much for all of the support![/b][/p][p][/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45548612/402c4031e6355de26e61bd8f6a07e27ab2ff1e14.png"][/img][/p]

notes.title: DREADTOME 1.1 - Achievements, Fixes & More!
notes.content: [p]DREADTOME [b]1.1[/b] has just released, bringing with it Steam achievements, a bunch of bug fixes, and general improvements.[/p][p][/p][h2]List of major changes:[/h2][list][*][p][b][u]Steam achievements[/u][/b] - Can you get them all?[/p][/*][*][p][b][u]Difficulty Select[/u][/b] - Do you dare try DREAD mode?[/p][/*][*][p][u][b]Rat Mode[/b][/u] - Get to know your favourite protagonist, Dread Guy, much better in Rat Mode![/p][/*][*][p][b][u]Keybinding[/u][/b] - Keybindings should be much less fussy now.[/p][/*][*][p][b][u]Settings[/u] [/b]- We fixed many bugs regarding the settings menu.[/p][/*][*][p][u][b]Ending[/b][/u] - We made a few changes to wrap-up your adventure in a more satisfying manner.[/p][/*][*][p][b][u]Enemies[/u][/b] - The archives' monsters now behave more life-like, turning to look at you as they hunt you down, and pursuing you more consistently where you think you may be safe.[/p][/*][*][p][b][u]Intro Skip[/u][/b] - For speedrunners or subsequent playthroughers, you can now skip the intro by holding E![/p][/*][*][p][u][b]Environment Art[/b][/u] - A lot has been added to the archives, making it all feel more uneasy to explore.[/p][/*][/list][p][/p][p]As our student project wraps up, this will be our [u]final major update[/u]. Please don't expect any new content additions. If any bugs pop up, we'll try our best to patch them up.[/p][p][/p][p]Thank you so much for playing and enjoying DREADTOME![/p][p][/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45548612/8734c7bb3f952e8f923fab8147c41ab6b266a701.png"][/img][/p]

notes.title: Game Release! - DREADTOME
notes.content: [p]Those of you brave enough to venture into the corrupted archives may now prove themselves.[/p][p][b]We've released DREADTOME's 1.0 version![/b][/p][p][/p][p]Please share your thoughts in our Steam forums, and any bugs via our in-game bug reporter.[/p][p]Have fun... if you survive.[/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45548612/d7d21fad3a5bf252e6584a256c44547563d83298.png"][/img][/p]
